The '''Department of Adjudication''', also called the '''The Adjudicators''', was a [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agency]] in charge of intervening in economic crime and corruption during the days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The Adjudicators were responsible for unraveling the transgressions of the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]]. Legally transferring the conglomerate's assets, the Adjudicators was able to save the [[galactic economy]] from collapsing.
